name: Giant spider
comment: The spider_red look's kit as the live capture's The Weaver and Giant spiders cast it (data/live-capture npc-movement.json): XX_Skew 197776 (bite), XX_Web 197778 (a lobbed web: a 3 m patch that slows 50%), XX_Silk Thread 198074 (hops next to the player), XX_Taunt 198187. Was a generic Venom + Stab (user: it shot a snake, not a web). XX_Spawn Spiders 198051 (hash YTZO) was never cast live and is left out.
